title: Add remote request audit records linking platform message IDs to Hermes sessions, workflow IDs, approvals, artifacts, commits, deploys, and dashboard events
summary: Ensure every remote operator request can be traced from platform message to Hermes workflow outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit records include request id, job id, source, user, project, action class, event type, outcome, platform message id, and artifacts.
Accepted and blocked requests both produce auditable outcomes.
Audit records can be mirrored into dashboard activity feeds later.
reviewNotes: Implemented RemoteAuditRecord and remote_audit_records with platform-message linkage and workflow routing outcomes.
